Name: Dawn's Hummingbird Wings for Fashion Sense
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
These are the wings that pair along with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25104]Dawn's Florist Gown[/url]. They can be used by themselves too of course. (ᵔ◡ᵔ)

These wings are part of the commission I received from [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Hiname/mods]Hiname[/url] to create her OC's outfit in Stardew Valley. I was so excited to make these wings! I never realized how beautiful hummingbird wings are until I started googling photos of them. This set includes one pair of wings in their default pink and green colors, and another set with a rainbow shine over them. Both pairs of wings can be tinted to other colors, but the rainbow effect may not show as well. To set them to their "true" colors, turn the saturation bar to 0 and the brightness bar to max.

These wings also flutter while both moving and standing still. I may make alternate versions with different motion settings in the future.


To install:
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]!
Unzip the file and move the folder "[FS] Dawn's Hummingbird Wings" into your StardewValley/mods folder. Done!


If you'd like to support my mods, [url=https://ko-fi.com/looneyluny]consider buying me a coffee[/url]. Don't feel obligated though. (￣▽￣*)ゞ I'll also be accepting commissions there in the future!
